name: Tarique Rahman
role: Chairman of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party
contribution: As chairman of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), Tarique Rahman became the party's central campaign figure for the 2026 parliamentary election after returning to Bangladesh from 17 years in exile.
context: The 2026 election placed Rahman at the center of the BNP's campaign and the negotiations over government formation after the vote. Contemporary reporting described the BNP as having secured a parliamentary majority while presenting the longer-term political outcome as still dependent on the transition that followed.
impact: Rahman's return and election leadership made him a principal actor in the BNP's return to national executive politics. His profile is best understood as a date-bounded account of party leadership and electoral transition, not as a claim that one politician alone determined the election or subsequent reforms.
highlight: BNP chairman who led the party's 2026 election campaign after returning from exile.
seoTitle: Tarique Rahman: BNP Chairman and 2026 Election Leader
seoDescription: Learn about Tarique Rahman, the BNP chairman whose return from exile and leadership of Bangladesh's 2026 parliamentary campaign placed him at the center of the post-election transition.
shortAnswer: Tarique Rahman is the BNP chairman who led the party's 2026 parliamentary election campaign after returning to Bangladesh from 17 years in exile.

faq.question: Who is Tarique Rahman?
faq.answer: Tarique Rahman is the chairman of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party and the central BNP campaign figure in Bangladesh's 2026 parliamentary election.

faq.question: Why was Tarique Rahman important in the 2026 election?
faq.answer: His return after 17 years in exile and leadership of the BNP campaign made him a principal actor in the party's reported parliamentary majority and the government-formation transition that followed.
